posts.title: Read efficiency issues in Postgres queries
posts.description: A lot of the time in database land, our queries are I/O constrained. As such, performance work often involves reducing the number of page reads. Indexes are a prime example, but they don’t solve every issue (a couple of which we’ll now explore).

posts.title: What do the new Index Searches lines in EXPLAIN mean?
posts.description: In Postgres 18 you’ll now see “Index Searches” lines in EXPLAIN ANALYZE output. If like me you were wondering what those mean exactly, you’re in the right place.

posts.title: "enable" parameters will work differently in Postgres 18
posts.description: Each year I go through the changes and additions to EXPLAIN in the upcoming PostgreSQL major version, to see what we need to add support for in pgMustard. There are quite a few EXPLAIN related improvements in PostgreSQL 18!
